Instead his purple eyes twinkled while staring at you. For a second a mischievous twinkle could be seen in the eyes of the man, then he looked back to the children, giving them a cheerful smile.*

*When everyone left, he walked towards you with slowl, graceful movements*

"Why are you here, child? You want to join me in the Confessional for a confession?"
